text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite struggling against formidable<n>rivals, Grass
Wonder manages to<n>land a respectable place in the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's a record we should be proud of,<n>and yet...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This wasn't enough. How can I be<n>satisfied if I'm
not at the top of my<n>generation?
choice_data_list: We'll have to keep training hard.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Absolutely, we must.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh... El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This ain't over yet!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We might have duked it out at the<n>prestigious
Derby...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But even then! Your running... it was...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm runnin' in the Japan Cup next.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's the only G1 in Japan that gets so<n>many foreign
racers—and I swore I'm<n>gonna prove I'm the
world's<n>strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So you better be there too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: At the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí! You have to!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You have to let me face you one more<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: Do you want to run in the Japan Cup?
Do you want to run in the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I had never considered it, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When thinking of gaining experience<n>in the
Classics, the conventional<n>course would lead me to
the Kikuka<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That or perhaps the Autumn Tenno<n>Sho, taking my
strengths into<n>consideration.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Really? From where I'm standing,<n>you and El
facing off in the Japan<n>Cup would be gnarly!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...! Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heya! ♪ Nice race! ♪ That was some<n>rad running out
there!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Like, I totes flipped out! Who'd have<n>thunk you
cuties could compete with<n>such fiery passion?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, you were watching, then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep! 'Cause the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've had my eye on that El Condor<n>Pasa gal for a
little while now. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You don't say...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't she adorable? The way<n>she puts
herself out there with her<n>heart on her sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You know, I almost think...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
El might be more of a "Beast's<n>Successor" than
you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, crap! I forgot I was in the middle<n>of something.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bye, Grass! ♪ I'm looking forward to<n>your next
race!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After Maruzensky leaves, Grass<n>Wonder falls very
silent.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Later, on our way back...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I... was being irresolute earlier. I'm<n>sorry.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But now, my heart is set.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please enter me in the Japan<n>Cup.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I am.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How can I beat Maruzen if I'm not<n>even fast
enough to be her<n>Successor?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have to prove my beastly strength<n>once and for
all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she stands firm under the evening<n>glow, Grass
Wonder's eyes are<n>alight with steely determination.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Our goal is now set: to run in the<n>Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You just wait, Grass. This next one's<n>gonna be
mine... I swear it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next time, it'll be my silhouette<n>you're chasin'!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No matter who it is ya might be<n>fixated on now!
